definitions.gloss: new life, fresh start, new lifestyle
definitions.explanation: A new phase or chapter of life, typically associated with moving, starting a new job, entering school, or getting married. Especially prominent in Japan's April season of new beginnings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{四月|しがつ}→四月：00668_shigatsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{新生活|しんせいかつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: My new life begins in April.

examples.japanese: {新生活|しんせいかつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧なもの⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧そろえた。
examples.english: I prepared the things needed for my new life.

examples.japanese: {新生活|しんせいかつ}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{期待|きたい}→期待：00238_kitai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|い}り{混|ま}じっている→入り混じる：11626_irimajiru⟧。
examples.english: Excitement and anxiety about the new life are mixed together.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, April marks the start of the fiscal and academic year. {新生活|しんせいかつ} is closely associated with this season, when many people move, start new jobs, or enter school. Stores run {新生活|しんせいかつ}⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧ (new life sales) promoting furniture, appliances, and household goods.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新生活|しんせいかつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}める: to start a new life
- {新生活|しんせいかつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧: preparations for a new life
- {新生活|しんせいかつ}⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧: new-life sale
- {新生活|しんせいかつ}⟦{応援|おうえん}→応援：01900_ouen⟧: new-life support (marketing term)
